recommendation: Keep the source correction as-is. It restores the final FHIR-13141 decision in the current build page while preserving later iterate wording and search-parameter corrections.
issue_request: FHIR-13141 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core search issue asking to remove "&criteria..." from _include and _revinclude examples because the suffix made it look as though criteria could control included resources.
initial_application: The issue was originally applied by git/SVN commit 15920d2c6d40113c747a70cb6790d4143a83162c, which removed &criteria... from the basic _include and _revinclude examples. A later search-page rewrite in 83529ed121dc9fc1d9aeb117b0fe8a6293f9f0c9 converted nearby examples to newer GET/POST display markup and carried &criteria... forward in _include/:iterate examples.
additional_context: source/search.html is an active core search narrative page, linked from source/documentation.html and maintained alongside search-rules in source/fhir.ini. Later issues FHIR-13602, FHIR-31951, and FHIR-46944 corrected or clarified the same iterate examples without approving criteria on included resources. FHIR-49638 later proposed conditional inclusion syntax but was retracted, and Zulip discussion confirmed additional criteria cannot be placed on included resources under current standard search syntax.
reconciliation: The published commit removes all remaining &criteria... suffixes from _include and _include:iterate examples in source/search.html, covering both GET and POST displays. Current source had no _revinclude examples with this suffix left to remove.
source_changes: source/search.html: removed &criteria... from the MedicationDispense _include plus _include:iterate GET and POST examples.
source/search.html: removed &criteria... from the Observation _include and _include:iterate GET and POST examples.

related_jiras.note: Changed the old recurse examples to iterate and retained the criteria suffix before this reconciliation.
Corrected the MedicationRequest iterate example to use requester and updated surrounding text without deciding conditional include criteria.
Clarified :iterate behavior for matches and inclusions without changing the criteria suffix.
The later conditional-inclusion proposal was retracted, supporting that criteria on included resources is not current standard syntax.
